global|CM550|0x0080060e.comment: The round-robin task of cm550_runEngineProtectionScheduler (CM848's engine_protection_task_index): 0 the over-limit durations, 1 the restart severity, 2 the fault derate fuel limit, 3 the engine speed limit and the fault logs, 4 the shutdown. It advances once per call while engine protection is enabled (it holds while EPEN is clear), wraps after 4 and is cleared by cm550_initializeEngineProtection. Typed ENGINE_PROTECTION_TASK (the enum was PROTECTION_STATE, which nothing used).

engine_protection_fault_log_entry_t: +0: key_on_hour_meter when the fault became active (move.l (0x80bda4),(a0) at 0x1939e in cm550_recordEngineProtectionFaultLogEntry); its low word is subtracted for the duration (0x19504-0x1950e)

+4: the input's extreme while the fault is active: 0xffff while configuration flag 0x8 is set, else 0 (0x193b2 / 0x193ba); with configuration flags 0xc it takes the input when cm550_isEngineProtectionInputMoreExtreme says so (read 0x19402, write 0x19428); CM848 types it short
+6: 0 while the entry is open (clr.w (0x6,a2) at 0x193a4), then key_on_hour_meter - occurrence_time (low words) when cm550_closeEngineProtectionFaultLogEntry closes it (0x19514)
engine_protection_channel_configuration_: +0x0 EP??CG 'CONFIGURATION WORD FOR EPF <input>': 0x1 fueling derate, 0x2 engine speed derate, 0x101 / 0x402 count the fueling / engine speed over-limit duration (0x18a4a / 0x18a78), 0x4 past the threshold when at or above it (else below) and the maximum is tracked, 0x8 with 0x4 clear the minimum is tracked, 0x30 a switch input: active when ((input & input_mask) != 0) equals (flags & 0x10 != 0) (0x1897c-0x189a2), 0x40 the fueling severity is the time-ramped index and the fueling restart index 0x100 (0x18c54), 0x300 / 0xc00 the fueling / engine speed shutdown (0x100 / 0x400 by the over-limit duration, else by the severity threshold; 0x190bc-0x1917e), 0x1000 the engine speed fault shares the fueling fault log (0x19612). Word reads at 0x18978 / 0x18a46 / 0x18bc2 / 0x18c2c / 0x18e34 / 0x1905a / 0x19560

+0x2 EP??FLDD 'TIME FROM OVERLIMIT REACHED TO STARTING FUEL DERATE' (SEC): rampEngineProtectionSeverityIndex ramps up once fueling_duration is above it (move.w (0x2,a2) at 0x186ca); cm550_calculateFaultDerateFuelLimit 0x197a2
+0x4 EP??RPDD 'TIME FROM ... REACHED TO STARTING RPM DERATE' (SEC): the engine speed side of the ramp (move.w (0x4,a2) at 0x186dc)
+0x6 EP??FLIC 'TIME TO REACH FULL DERATE DURING <input> ENGINE PROTECTION' (1/256 per step): the fueling severity step of rampEngineProtectionSeverityIndex (move.w (0x6,a2) at 0x186ce)
+0x8 EP??RPIC: the engine speed severity step (move.w (0x8,a2) at 0x186e0)

+0xa EP??MNTD 'MINIMUM THRESHOLD FOR <input> FUEL LIMITING' (coolant temperature: ADCLTPMN): cm550_initializeEngineProtection points the state's minimum_threshold_pointer at it (config + 10 at 0x18782, channels 1 2 4-8); read through the pointer at 0x189bc / 0x18c6c / 0x197ae
+0xc EP??MXTD (coolant temperature: ADCLTPMX): the target of maximum_threshold_pointer (config + 12 at 0x1878a); read through it at 0x18c66 / 0x197a8 (the interpolation maximum)
+0xe EP??RPLL 'MINIMUM THRESHOLD FOR <input> RPM LIMITING': the target of engine_speed_lower_limit_pointer (config + 14 at 0x18794); read through it at 0x189e0

+0x10 EP??FLSD 'SHUTDOWN THRESHOLD FOR <input> FUELING' (SEC): threshold select 2 of cm550_isEngineProtectionInputPastThreshold (move.w (0x10,a1) at 0x189ca) and the fueling duration limit of the shutdown (cmp.w (0x10,a3) at 0x190da)
+0x12 EP??RPSD (SEC): threshold select 2 on the engine speed side (0x189ee) and the engine speed duration limit of the shutdown (0x19184)

+0x14 EP??SODY / EPFTFSDY 'SHUTDOWN DELAY FOR <input> SHUTDOWN' (SEC): copied into the state's start warning time in the engine start pass (move.w (0x14,a0) at 0x18fbc / 0x18fc4, incrementDiagnosticCounters)
+0x16 EP??SRRP 'RPM TO REACH BEFORE <input> ERRORS' (RPM): logEngineProtectionChannelFaults starts the errors-allowed timer once engine_rpm_primary is above it (0x19564 / 0x1957e)

+0x18 EP??SRTM 'DELAY AFTER RPM REACHED BEFORE <input> ERRORS' (SEC): errors are allowed once errors_allowed_timer reaches it (0x1956c / 0x195be); with this and start_monitor_engine_speed both 0 errors are always allowed

+0x1a EP??FLFU 'FAULT INDEX INDICATING EPF <input> FUEL ERROR FOUND': the fault bit cm550_recordEngineProtectionFaultLogEntry sets in 0x806000 / 0x806040 and cm550_closeEngineProtectionFaultLogEntry tests and clears (move.w (0x1a,a0) at 0x19352 / 0x19452); dump: 111 34 15 53 125 0 0 39 0
+0x1c EP??RPFU: the engine speed fault bit (0x19372 / 0x19472); dump: 112 109 108 54 294 161 163 40 0

+0x1e EP??WNTM 'TIME DURATION TO WARN DRIVER BEFORE SHUTDOWN DUE TO <input>' (SEC): the shutdown command once the shutdown time count passes the start warning time + this (0x19144 / 0x191f4); the restart limitation command once fueling_duration passes it (0x18df0)

+0x20 EP??FLSS 'SHUTDOWN THRESHOLD FOR <input> FUELING' (input units): threshold select 3 of cm550_isEngineProtectionInputPastThreshold (move.w (0x20,a1) at 0x189d6), the fueling shutdown by severity (select 3 at 0x190fa)
+0x22 EP??RPSS: threshold select 3 on the engine speed side (0x189fa; shutdown 0x191a6)
cm550_engine_protection_channel_state_t: +0x0 EP??SA 'POINTER TO SOURCE OF <input> INPUT': set by cm550_initializeEngineProtection (move.l #0x8091e6,(a2) at 0x1875a: coolant level switch; 0x80a336 coolant temperature; 0x80a26a engine_protection_intake_manifold_temperature; 0x80a30a oil pressure; 0x80a46a water in fuel; 0x80a320 boost; 0x80a2f4 engine sync fuel pressure; 0x80a254 engine_protection_fuel_temperature; 0x80a3ba ambient air pressure); read movea.l (a2),a0 / move.w (a0) at 0x18980 / 0x18c62 / 0x1968c
+0x4 EP??SAMK 'MASK FOR INPUT OF <input>': the switch bit of a 0x30 channel (and.w (0x4,a2),d2 at 0x18986); 1 for coolant level (move.w #1,(0x4,a2) at 0x18760)

+0x6 EP??FLTM 'AMOUNT OF TIME SINCE <input> FAILURE WAS DETECTED' (SEC): counted up to 0xffff while the input is past its fueling threshold (0x18a64-0x18a72), 0 while errors are not allowed (0x18aa8); read by the ramp (0x186c6), the shutdown (0x190d6) and the restart limitation (0x18dde)
+0x8 EP??RPTM: the engine speed over-limit duration (0x18a94-0x18aa2, 0x18aac; ramp 0x186d8; shutdown 0x19180)

+0xa EP??MNSA 'POINTER TO <input> FUEL MIN THRESHOLD': &configuration.fueling_minimum_threshold (0x18786), for oil pressure 0x80dabe (the low oil pressure limit for the present engine speed, 0x187f2); threshold select 0 (0x189bc) and the interpolation minimum (0x18c6c)
+0xe EP??MXSA: &configuration.fueling_maximum_threshold (0x18790); the interpolation maximum (0x18c66); not set for coolant level and oil pressure

+0x12 EP??RLSA 'POINTER TO <input> RPM LIMIT THRESHOLD': &configuration.engine_speed_lower_limit_threshold (0x1879a), for oil pressure 0x80dac0 (the very low oil pressure limit, 0x187fa); threshold select 0 on the engine speed side (0x189e0)

+0x16 EP??EREN 'TRUE = <input> ERROR ALLOWED': set by logEngineProtectionChannelFaults (0x19574 / 0x195cc), cleared at 0 rpm (0x1959e); gates the duration counts (0x18a40), the shutdown (0x190c6 / 0x19170) and the restart limitation (0x18dd8)

+0x18 EP??PKER '<input> SYSTEM ERROR DETECTED BEFORE CRANKING IN RESTART': set by cm550_examineEngineProtectionBeforeCranking (move.w #1,(0x18,a2) at 0x18be2 / 0x18c0c); makes both faults active in logEngineProtectionChannelFaults (0x195e2)

+0x1a EP??FSCU 'AMOUNT OF TIME OVER <input> FUEL SHUTDOWN THRESHOLD' (SEC): counted by incrementDiagnosticCounters (0x18f96-0x18f9e), cleared by processDiagnosticLimitStatus (0x190f0 / 0x19216 / 0x192bc); a fueling fault while nonzero (0x195f6)

+0x1e EP??FSWT / EPFTFLWN 'DELAY BEFORE WARNING ABOUT SHUTDOWN FROM <input> FUEL' (SEC): = configuration.shutdown_delay in the engine start pass (0x18fbc); the shutdown approaching flag once the time count passes it (0x1912e), the shutdown command once it passes it + shutdown_warning_time (0x1913e)
+0x20 EP??RSWT / EPFTRPWN: the engine speed side (0x18fc4, 0x191de, 0x191ee)
+0x22 EP??ERTM 'TIME SINCE RPM CROSSED <input> START MON RPM' (SEC): counted while errors_allowed_timer_running (0x195c6), 0 at 0 rpm (0x195a4)
+0x24 EP??ERFG 'ERRORS ALLOWED TIMER RUNNING FLAG FOR <input>': set above start_monitor_engine_speed (0x1958c), cleared at 0 rpm (0x195aa)

+0x26 EP??FLSA 'POINTER TO <input> FUEL FAULT LOG DATA': the channel's 5-entry fueling fault log (cm550_initializeEngineProtection, e.g. 0x805562 at 0x18766); read movea.l (0x26,a0) at 0x1935c / 0x1945c

+0x2a EP??RPSA: the engine speed fault log (the same log as the fueling one for coolant temperature and intake manifold temperature; not set for coolant level, whose configuration flag 0x1000 folds the engine speed fault into the fueling log); read at 0x1937c / 0x1947c
engine_protection_channel_history_t: +0x0 EP??FLIX '<input> FUELING SEVERITY INDEX' (1/256): written by cm550_calculateFaultDerateFuelLimit (move.w d3,(a4) at 0x197fa; oil pressure forced to 0x100 at 0x1987c); read by the ramp (0x186c4), processDiagnosticLimitStatus (0x1909a) and logEngineProtectionChannelFaults (0x195f0)
+0x2 EP??RPIX 'SEVERITY INDEX FOR EPF <input> FAULT' (1/256): written by cm550_calculateFaultDerateEngineSpeedLimit (move.w d3,(0x2,a2) at 0x18ed4); read by the ramp (0x186d4), 0x190a6 and 0x19600

+0x4 EP??FLRI / EPFTRYIX '<input> FUELING RESTART SEVERITY INDEX': written by updateEngineProtectionRestartSeverityIndexes (0x18c4c / 0x18c5a / 0x18c7c), zeroed by cm550_updateEngineProtectionRestartSeverity (0x18d8a); the floor of the fueling severity (0x197c6)
+0x6 EP??RPRI / EPFTRRIX: written at 0x18ca0 / 0x18caa, zeroed at 0x18d8e; the floor of the engine speed severity (0x18ea0)
+0x8 EP??EX '<input> EXTREMITY': the input's maximum or minimum (configuration flags 0xc), read at 0x19694 and written at 0x196a8 by logEngineProtectionChannelFaults; CM848 types it short

+0xe EP??FLET / EPFTFFET 'TOTAL TIME <input> FUEL FAULT HAS BEEN ACTIVE' (SEC): addq.l #1,(0xe,a0) at 0x19622 / 0x19644
+0x12 EP??RPET / EPFTRFET 'TOTAL TIME <input> RPM FAULT HAS BEEN ACTIVE' (SEC): addq.l #1,(0x12,a0) at 0x19664
+0x16 EP??FLFG 'FAULT LOG RECORDING FLAG FOR <input> FUELING': 1 while the fueling log entry is open (history + 22: 0x19366 / 0x1938e set, 0x194fe clear)
+0x18 EP??FLIN 'INDEX INTO EPF FAULT LOG FOR <input> FUELING' (0-4): the current entry (move.w (0x18,a0) at 0x1934c; advanced modulo 5 at 0x19518-0x19524)
